tasks.quote: - **60 qualified tasks** from public open-source repositories, across **4 contract scales** and **7 source languages**, split evenly between in-place optimization (30) and cross-language rewriting into Rust or Go (30).

verifier.full_credit: Passes all three gates: compliance, functional equivalence on every held-out probe (zero partial credit), and worst-case speedup clearing the noise threshold.
verifier.quote: **Strict success** requires all three gates. Every attempt falls into exactly one outcome: *Compliance Failure*, *Functional Failure*, *Slower* ($r < 1$), *Noise-Bound* ($1 \le r \le \theta_{\text{trial}}$), or *Strict Success*.

oracle.quote: During grading, the verifier runs the submission and the reference as separate users with no network access, and refuses to grade if any of these isolation checks fails.
